name: Fuwei Intelligent
summary: Fuwei Intelligent is a Guangzhou developer of industrial robots and factory automation systems. Its portfolio includes humanoid robots, mobile manipulators, embodied intelligence controllers and flexible assembly systems. The company combines its GRID industrial model with robot control, visual perception and workflow tools for manufacturing tasks.
